title: JANUS Engine — TOPA + Spider refined magnetic Axle drive selection
mission: Choose the magnetic architecture that most directly simplifies JANUS startup while preserving a low parasitic budget and bidirectional battery/regeneration capability.

coreless_AFPM.evidence: 2024-2025 reviews of coreless/slotless axial-flux PM machines report very low rotational loss, absence or strong suppression of slot-effect cogging, minimal torque ripple and suitability for bidirectional motor/generator service.
references: IEEE Transactions on Transportation Electrification 2025, DOI 10.1109/TTE.2025.3576361

electropermanent_magnets.result: reopened as a small-scale experimental branch rather than rejected categorically
evidence: A microfluidic EPM experiment switched with about 5.8 mJ per 50 us pulse and required no static power after switching.
A 2024 EPM soft-robot valve reported about 47 mJ per reliable 500 us switching event and zero holding power between events.

A machine-scale variable-flux memory motor experiment reported re/de-magnetization losses in the tens of joules, demonstrating that pulse cost scales strongly with magnetic volume/topology and cannot be assumed negligible.
references: Electropermanent magnet actuation for droplet ferromicrofluidics, 2016
Transactions of China Electrotechnical Society 2023, VFMM pulse-trajectory losses
electropermanent_magnets.boundary: EPM pole-by-pole switching is viable for JANUS only if a small custom pole can generate the required torque across the actual air gap while keeping total switching energy within the measured auxiliary budget.

active_torque_compensation.evidence: Position-synchronous harmonic current injection is an established method to cancel cogging/torque ripple, but all coil and inverter losses must be counted.

battery_hybridization.evidence: Modern PEMFC-battery hybrid work uses the battery as transient/startup buffer while the fuel cell supplies sustained power; bidirectional power electronics allow surplus/regeneration to restore SOC.

refined_decision.reason: It avoids intentionally creating a magnetic braking barrier and then paying to cancel it. The same compact machine starts the Axle from the battery, holds RPM, and regenerates when a real hydraulic/mechanical source drives the rotor.
refined_decision.reason_for_reopening: Small EPMs have demonstrated milli-joule switching, which can fit JANUS single-digit-watt budgets at moderate RPM if the required field/torque is achievable at that scale.
refined_decision.do_not_use_as_default: machine-scale repeated magnetization-state switching until measured pulse energy, air-gap force and thermal behavior prove it beats the coreless AFPM baseline

sequence: EXTERNAL_CHARGE: battery charged from outside before startup
SPINUP: battery drives coreless AFPM starter-generator and water/gas auxiliaries
GILL_GRADIENT_BUILD: battery carries transient deficit while internal pO2 and membrane flux converge
LOAD_TRANSFER: PEMFC progressively takes the DC-bus load
SOC_RECOVERY: first positive surplus recharges the battery to reserve setpoint
EXPORT: only surplus above internal loads and reserve-recovery demand is exported
battery_startup_synergy.self_drive_rule: With external charger disconnected, stabilized SOC must be non-decreasing over the declared hold interval after all magnetic-drive, pump, fan and controller losses are included.
